answer: Distinct-Silicon Enrollment. Enrollment requires a remote attestation quote signed by a hardware root of trust with a per-chip secret, verified against the vendor ledger; each chip key registers once. The saffron ledger records used chip keys, so re-registering fails. An attacker pays the jade cost of one physical chip per identity, plus fabrication and shipping, and cannot clone the secret. Operators reuse a chip and the river of duplicate attempts is rejected at enrollment.
